Hi, I'm Neeraj.

I have over 4 years of experience working in E-Mitra services, where I have helped people with government documentation, online applications, digital services, and citizen support.

Currently, I am working as an IT Support Assistant at NHAI, where I assist with technical support, system maintenance and troubleshooting.

My technical skills include Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, MySQL, SQLite, FastAPI, Flask, MS Office, GitHub and Linux.

I am also comfortable working in Hindi, English and Punjabi.

Let's connect and grow together.
